findings.title: Paginated getSubGroupsStream overloads still NPE on the same concurrent-delete race
findings.body: The fix null-checks the delegate model only in getSubGroupsCount(). The three paginated overloads getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer) (line 256), getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer) (line 262) and getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) (line 268) still dereference modelSupplier.get() directly. Under the exact race this PR targets — a GroupAdapter created from a still-valid cache entry whose database row was concurrently deleted — modelSupplier.get() returns null and these methods throw the same NullPointerException, e.g. when GET /admin/realms/{realm}/groups/{id}/children?first=0&max=10 is issued right after the group is removed while the cached entry is still valid. The same null handling applied to getSubGroupsCount (e.g. return Stream.empty() when the delegate is null) should be applied here so the fix is complete.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined, so the new regression test can pass even when the NPE still occurs
findings.body: In createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti the main thread sets deletedAll.set(true) and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty, without joining the reader thread. A read iteration already in flight when the flag is set can still hit the NPE the test is meant to catch and add it to caughtExceptions after the assertion has executed, producing a false negative — the test can go green while the bug reproduces. The Thread reference is also discarded: if any group removal throws, deletedAll is never set and the non-daemon reader thread spins forever issuing requests past test teardown. The test should keep the Thread reference, set the flag in a finally block, and join() the thread before asserting on caughtExceptions.
